brokers.thesis: EBITDA beat by 15%; transition from a single-product suspension maker to a diversified mobility platform; FY28E EPS raised 15% after dilution, mainly for the acquisitions; EPS CAGR 16% FY26-28E on restated FY26.

Core suspension franchise plus group consolidation; FY28E PAT Rs787 cr = standalone Rs350 cr + sunroof (65%) Rs28 cr + group companies Rs254 cr + 29% of HL Mando Anand Rs155 cr; Rs30/share added for HL Klemove.

Acquisitions improve the long-term story (multiple raised from 28x to 32x) but the stock has rallied; sunroof disruption, commodity inflation, higher leverage and integration risk weigh on the near term.
SOTP: Dana Anand and Henkel Anand at 14x EV/EBITDA, HL Mando Anand and HL Klemove at deal value (Rs523/share), core business at 37x blended FY27-28E EPS of Rs31.1 (Rs1,151/share).

moat: Scale and share in ride control
Leader in CV (88%) and electric 2W (~60%); 32% in 2W/3W and 25% in PV; 500+ models; but Munjal Showa, ZF/Sachs, Endurance, KYB, Tenneco and Mando compete
Platform-level supply for the life of a model; long relationships (TVS, HMSI, Maruti, Tata, Ashok Leyland); but PV share slipped in Q1FY27 as it is absent from some fast-growing UVs

Licensed and partner technology (Marelli suspension licence, Inalfa sunroofs, KYB legacy, Henkel, Dana, HL Mando, HL Klemove); 34 patents granted; own R&D in Hosur, Chakan and Belgium. The know-how in the new businesses sits with foreign partners
Commodity pass-through with a lag; margins 6-10% for two decades; Q1FY27 margin fell on input costs
Minority stakes in high-return JVs (Dana ROE 33%, Henkel 62%, HL Mando ~19%) where partners control technology and the board; Gabriel's earnings now depend on profits it does not control
critiques: Related-party consolidation: the promoter sold Gabriel a 28.99% stake in HL Mando Anand for Rs1,881 cr of new shares plus Rs350 cr of cash; the price (21.5x FY26 PAT) was set by valuers appointed by the board, and the audit committee and AGM approved it, but minority holders paid in stock priced at ~54x restated FY26 EPS.

Quality of earnings is changing: ~30% of restated FY26 profit before tax, and ~45% of our FY28E, is a share of JV/associate profit, which is non-cash until paid out as dividends and is controlled by foreign partners (Dana, Henkel, HL).
The core business is a low-margin supplier: consolidated EBITDA margin 8.7% in Q1FY27, 6-10% for 20 years; it lost PV share in Q1FY27.
Leverage arrives for the first time: Rs1,000 cr of NCDs and Rs237 cr of deferred consideration; interest goes from ~Rs26 cr to ~Rs100 cr a year.

History is not comparable: FY24-FY25 are pre-scheme, FY26 is restated, the restated Q1FY26/Q4FY26 undertaking figures were not reviewed by the auditor, and FY27 includes the Jupiter stakes for part of the year only.
Sunroof dilution: Inalfa is to take 35% of IGSS (PN3 approval pending), which would cut Gabriel's share of a 15%-margin business.
gaps: HL Klemove India's profit after tax was not disclosed by the company (only FY26 revenue Rs1,049 cr and adjusted EBITDA ~Rs129 cr); we assume PAT at 55% of adjusted EBITDA (Arihant's ~Rs143 cr looks inconsistent with the EBITDA).

Closing date of the HL Klemove purchase: the SPA/JVA were executed on 21-Aug-2026 and tranche 1 (US$73.83 mn) was due by 15-Sep-2026; we found no exchange filing confirming payment by 30-Sep-2026 and treat it as closed in Sep-2026.

Restated consolidated balance sheet at Mar-2026 (and Jun-2026) was not published by 30-Sep-2026: our pro forma uses restated reserves (Rs1,935.5 cr) and estimates the split of the scheme's net assets.
Restated Q2FY26 and Q3FY26 were not published separately; we split the restated half-year.
Equity-method carrying values of the Dana and Henkel stakes: we use the stake times FY26 net worth.
Purchase-price allocation for the HL Mando Anand and HL Klemove stakes (amortisation of fair-value uplifts inside the share of profit) not known; not modelled.
Dividends the JVs pay Gabriel: not disclosed for the restated FY26.
IGSS dilution to 65%: timing of the PN3 approval unknown; we keep 100%.
Anand Rathi, Elara and Nuvama notes after Q1FY27 not found; Motilal Oswal's EPS figures not in the public summary.
HL Mando Anand FY27 outlook: no guidance; we grow its PAT ~12%.
conflicts: HL Klemove price in rupees: Rs948 cr (Autocar Pro) vs Rs935 cr (Daily Pioneer) for US$98.44 mn; we use Rs948 cr.
HL Klemove PAT: Arihant ~Rs143 cr vs adjusted EBITDA ~Rs129 cr (company); PAT cannot exceed EBITDA without large other income; we do not use Arihant's figure.
ICICI Securities writes the HL Klemove consideration as '~Rs98 crore' (it is US$98.44 mn).
FY26 standalone revenue: Rs4,223 cr (CFO, Q4 call) vs Rs4,233 cr (Screener, incl. other operating revenue).
